name: Heavy Advance
intel: Heavy units on a narrow U-path. Both corners are chokepoints — Cannon at each bend.

name: Fragmenters
intel: Fragmenter: splits into 3 Corrupted Nodes on death. Cannon splash handles the fragments automatically.

name: Fragment Swarm
intel: Fragmenters plus Swarm. When they die, swarms multiply — do not let the fragments escape the bend.

name: Shielded Splitters
intel: Shieldbearer protects the Fragmenters. Kill the shield source first or fragments get through.

name: Heavy Bend Finale
intel: Maximum pressure. Slow at both corners, AoE for swarms and fragments, Sniper for supports.
